title: Cross-system references
description: Reference grammar for pointers out of SSoR (spec §5.1). References are pointers, not copies: the target system remains the authority for the referenced fact.

externalRef.description: dsor:evidence/<id> — DSoR's record of an action outcome. dsor:read/<id> — a DSoR read response cited in a trace. dsor:action/<id> — the action request, for correlation. ksor:<doc>@gen-<n> — a cited KSoR document at a specific generation.

traceCorrelation.description: The trace id passed to DSoR when acting; evidence arriving without it is flagged 'uncorrelated' (B-23).
